CancelDeployment.note: Canceling a deployment cancels the backing IoT Job and resolves the thing/thing-group target with the caller's credentials.

DeleteCoreDevice.note: Deleting a core device resolves the device's deployment job executions with the caller's credentials (documented dependent action).

reviewed.iot:DescribeJobExecution: See the note: Deleting a core device resolves the device's deployment job executions with the caller's credentials (documented dependent action).

GetConnectivityInfo.note: Connectivity info is stored in IoT Core; Greengrass reads it with the caller's credentials (documented dependent action).

reviewed.iot:GetThingShadow: See the note: Connectivity info is stored in IoT Core; Greengrass reads it with the caller's credentials (documented dependent action).

GetCoreDevice.note: Core devices are IoT things; Greengrass authorizes the IoT-side lookup with the caller's credentials before resolving the device (observed "not authorized to call Iot Core services for thing" without it).

reviewed.iot:DescribeThing: See the note: Core devices are IoT things; Greengrass authorizes the IoT-side lookup with the caller's credentials before resolving the device (observed "not authorized to call Iot Core services for thing" without it).

GetDeployment.note: Deployments are backed by IoT Jobs; reading one resolves the job and the thing/thing-group target with the caller's credentials.

ListDeployments.note: Enumerating deployments resolves each deployment's backing IoT Job and thing/thing-group target with the caller's credentials.

reviewed.iot:DescribeJob: See the note: Enumerating deployments resolves each deployment's backing IoT Job and thing/thing-group target with the caller's credentials.
reviewed.iot:DescribeThing: See the note: Enumerating deployments resolves each deployment's backing IoT Job and thing/thing-group target with the caller's credentials.
reviewed.iot:DescribeThingGroup: See the note: Enumerating deployments resolves each deployment's backing IoT Job and thing/thing-group target with the caller's credentials.
reviewed.iot:GetThingShadow: See the note: Enumerating deployments resolves each deployment's backing IoT Job and thing/thing-group target with the caller's credentials.

ListEffectiveDeployments.note: Effective deployments are backed by IoT Jobs; enumerating them resolves each job, its execution on the device, and the thing/thing-group target with the caller's credentials (documented dependent actions).

reviewed.iot:DescribeThingGroup: See the note: Effective deployments are backed by IoT Jobs; enumerating them resolves each job, its execution on the device, and the thing/thing-group target with the caller's credentials (documented dependent actions).
